description_expanded: High Pointe 3-433 — 30A Gulf View Escape w/ Pool & Beach Access Favorite Features: - Gulf Front Bar and Grill - Tennis and Pickleball Courts - Community Pool About High Pointe 3-433: Escape to the beauty of Florida’s Emerald Coast in this stunning 2-bedroom, 2-bath Gulf-view condo located in the heart of Seacrest Beach along Scenic 30A. Situated on the fourth floor with convenient elevator access, this spacious coastal retreat features charming beachy décor and offers the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and resort-style amenities for families, couples, or friends traveling together. Wake up to breathtaking Gulf views from your private balcony, sip your morning coffee while listening to the waves, and spend your days enjoying the sugar-white sand and emerald waters just steps away via the community beach access. Guests have access to an incredible array of amenities including a large resort-style pool, relaxing hot tub, tennis and pickleball courts, a playground for the kids, and an on-site bar and grille perfect for casual dining and sunset cocktails. After a day at the beach, unwind in the beautifully furnished living space or explore nearby Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach with their charming shops, restaurants, and scenic bike paths. Whether you’re looking for a relaxing beach escape or an adventure-filled 30A getaway, this Seacrest Beach condo is the perfect place to make lasting memories.
